topics.title: Speech Architecture: The Hook, Core Message & Memorable Call to Action
topics.objective: Structure presentations using the classic 3-act framework: provocative opening, 3 key points, and definitive closing.
topics.example: Structure: Hook (Story/Stat) -> Problem -> 3 Supporting Arguments -> Vision -> Call to Action
topics.exercise: Outline a 5-minute persuasive speech on a topic of choice following the 3-act structure.

topics.title: Audience Analysis & Empathetic Framing
topics.objective: Tailor language, tone, and examples to the specific knowledge level, priorities, and emotional state of the audience.
topics.example: Technical team: Focus on architecture trade-offs; Executive team: Focus on ROI and risk mitigation.
topics.exercise: Rewrite the same core proposal into two versions: one for technical peers and one for non-technical executives.

topics.title: Vocal Variety: Pace, Pitch, Pauses & Projection
topics.objective: Eliminate filler words (um, ah, like) using deliberate pauses and vary vocal cadence for dramatic emphasis.
topics.example: The Power of the Pause: Stop for 2 full seconds before and after delivering the core takeaway.
topics.exercise: Record a 2-minute speech delivery focusing on eliminating all filler words through intentional pauses.

topics.title: Non-Verbal Communication: Eye Contact, Posture & Purposeful Gestures
topics.objective: Maintain commanding open stage presence, triangular eye contact, and gestures that emphasize key metrics.
topics.example: Ground feet shoulder-width apart; hold eye contact with one individual for a complete sentence.
topics.exercise: Practice delivering a 3-minute speech while maintaining open posture and deliberate gesture timing.

topics.title: Handling Q&A Sessions, Objections & Stage Anxiety
topics.objective: Employ the Listen-Acknowledge-Answer framework for tough audience questions and manage adrenaline spikes.
topics.example: Tough Question Strategy: "That is a critical point regarding scalability. Here is how we address that..."
topics.exercise: Simulate an antagonistic Q&A session with 3 challenging audience objections and deliver composed responses.
